I’m currently a Pre-doctoral Research Assistant in Marketing at London Business School. I'm interested in the causes and consequences of social inequality and how they change over time. I strive to combine statistical, demographic and experimental evidence with historical-sociological explanations and narratives.

Previously, I obtained my MPhil degree with Distinction in Sociology and Demography at the University of Oxford and my BSc degree with First Class Honours in Social Sciences with Data Science at University College London.
